## Bug Description

The tree sharing dialog uses `min-w-[600px]` even when opened from the mobile management sheet. On screens narrower than 600px, the dialog can clip or overflow horizontally.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the application at a phone viewport such as 375 × 667.
2. Open mobile Tree Management.
3. Open the sharing dialog for a tree.
4. Inspect the dialog width and content access rows.

## Expected Behavior

The dialog fits the viewport, remains scrollable vertically, and stacks dense sharing/access controls where needed.

## Actual Behavior

The fixed 600px minimum width exceeds common phone viewports.

## Environment

- Reviewed revision: `974cf7c`
- App version: `1.7.1`
- Mobile viewport below 600px

## Relevant Files/Components

- `frontend/src/components/view/database-management-view/dialog/ShareTreeDialog.tsx`
- Mobile management sheet/component
- Share dialog tests

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No horizontal overflow at 320px, 375px, and 430px widths.
- [ ] Apply the wider minimum only at an appropriate breakpoint.
- [ ] Content-access controls and invite rows stack or wrap readably.
- [ ] Keyboard focus and nested confirmation dialogs remain usable.
- [ ] Add a visual/responsive regression test and changelog entry.

## Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] Searched existing issues.
- [x] Included viewport and affected component.
- [x] Reviewed the current main revision.
